prereg_lock.note: Frozen before any C30 measurement artefact existed. The block from '## C30.0.1 Why this experiment exists' onward is copied verbatim into reports/section_c30_crossing_head_seeds.md; tests/test_crossing_head_seeds.py asserts the copy is byte-identical and that this file's mtime strictly precedes every C30 artefact.

question: does C28's crossing -- guided decoding above the oracle-selected best-of-N frontier at small budgets -- survive the probe-training seed?
comparator: C26's oracle-selected best-of-N curve, held FIXED across head seeds because it selects with RDKit and does not depend on the head

G1.rule: C29 seed-1234 checkpoint identical to C28's, tensor by tensor, max abs diff exactly 0.0

G2.rule: head seed 1234 reproduces C28 exactly: hit-rate and token residual 0.0 per generation seed, molecules identical

run_but_not_scored.why_not_scored: run as part of C30.0.2's 4 strands x 2 k, but not one of C28's eight winning cells, so no pre-registered rule applies to it

cited_not_rerun.why_not_rerun: C30.0.2 -- this is C26's D2 arm, already replicated across head seeds by C26 D2b (n=3) and C29 R6 (n=8)

D1_crossing_survives.rule: head-seed mean advantage over the oracle curve > 0 on >= 5 of 8 cells
D1_crossing_survives.note: A3_k8 was not re-run (C30.0.2) and is not counted as positive here; the rule is therefore scored conservatively against C30's own claim

D2_crossing_confirmed.rule: >= 3 of 8 cells additionally have a t interval on 7 df strictly above 0

D3_deployed_cell_survives.rule: A1 at k=2 -- the only deployed configuration -- has mean > 0 with a t interval strictly above 0

D4_sign_stability.rule: >= 75% of the (cell, head seed) points are positive

D5_crossing_refuted.rule: fewer than 3 of 8 cells keep a positive head-seed mean

D6_not_resolvable_at_one_seed.rule: for each cell, is the head-seed sd of the advantage larger than C28's own single-seed margin for that cell?

validity_screen.rule: C30.0.8 -- any cell with validity < 0.90 makes C30 UNINTERPRETABLE and leaves the decision rules unscored

sensitivity_S1_drop_cells_failing_the_va.status: POST HOC, NOT PRE-REGISTERED -- reported beside the pre-registered verdict, not in place of it
sensitivity_S1_drop_cells_failing_the_va.why_whole_cell_not_just_the_failing_seed: dropping only the failing head seed would be selecting on the outcome; the whole cell goes, including its seven passing seeds
sensitivity_S1_drop_cells_failing_the_va.note: D1 and D2 are scored against their ORIGINAL thresholds of 5 and 3 out of 8 pre-registered cells, not rescaled to the smaller denominator -- rescaling would make the rule easier to pass after dropping a cell

P1_at_least_six_of_eight_positive.predicted: >= 6 of 8 cells keep a positive head-seed mean

P2_largest_margin_survives.predicted: A3 k=2 keeps a t interval excluding zero

P3_deployed_cell_survives.predicted: A1 k=2 keeps a t interval excluding zero

P4_smallest_margin_does_not_survive.predicted: C2 k=2 does NOT keep a t interval excluding zero, and fires D6

P5_at_least_one_sign_change.predicted: at least one cell's mean advantage changes sign against C28

P6_advantage_sd_exceeds_hit_rate_sd_some.predicted: the head-seed sd of the ADVANTAGE exceeds that of the hit rate alone for at least one cell, because the budget moves too

P7_sds_inside_c29_band.predicted: hit-rate head-seed sd inside C29's measured 0.0142-0.0366 band on >= 3 of 4 strands
